correctness.rationale: PASS: A uniform sphere direction factors as (sqrt(1-Z²)V,Z), with independent V and Z. The support-function identity W=S w_B(V)+H|Z| is exact; beta integrals produce a,b,p,q,r. The second moment is p(1+eta)+2rt+qt² and the mean a+bt, so a direct positive definite quadratic-form completion gives the displayed exact defect identity. Opposite monotonicity of S and |Z| yields r<ab, so tau_d>0, while 1 not lying in the span of S,T proves gamma_d>0. eta=0 iff B has constant width. The large-d limit follows d(S-1)->-G²/2 and sqrt(d)|Z|->|G| with moment control, giving the Gaussian regression residual. Independently checked dimension-three gamma ~0.00567569671895 and tau ~0.751938393884. No extrapolation from finite numerical d tests.
